messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當球被直接向上投擲時，重力會使它產生一個向下的加速度。這個加速度（忽略空氣阻力）大約是：

\[
a \approx -9.8 \text{ 米/秒}^2
\]

負號表示方向與初始運動方向相反，即向下。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want the acceleration of a ball thrown upward at 5 m/s. But acceleration due to gravity is constant downward -9.8 m/s^2 (or 9.8 m/s^2 magnitude). So answer: acceleration is -9.8 m/s^2 (downward). They might ask "maximum height"? No, they ask "what acceleration". So we can respond: acceleration due to gravity is approximately -9.8 m/s^2. We don't need to call function.
